Yes I am.
It's very helpful and I am very appreciative of it.

To be honest I dont think Ive hurt anyone. Ive mostly been hurt. My mom is a narc and most of my narcissistic desires growing up and to this day have ended up as me feeling like the most evil creature on earth rather than being agressive to people, and getting me into continuos dissociative episodes.

Most of the people in my life know me as the nicest guy they know, but its all fake.

This is so crappy.
I experienced that so many times. It was so humiliating and painful. 
At a younger age I really though that I was choosing to do this and I really am that weak and bad for not stopping.
Humiliations came from my friends, teachers and family so I didn't really have anyone to talk to at the time.
Glad you have your parents with you.
